# Suppress false positives for properties not defined in reusable workflow outputs
property ".+" is not defined in object type {}

# Allow token load balancer secrets in workflows where actionlint lacks secret typing.
property "(token_rotation_json|service_bot_pat|actions_bot_pat|owner_pr_pat|agents_automation_pat|workflows_app_id|workflows_app_private_key|keepalive_app_id|keepalive_app_private_key|gh_app_id|gh_app_private_key|app_1_id|app_1_private_key|app_2_id|app_2_private_key)" is not defined in object type .+

# Suppress actionlint false positive for 'models' permission (GitHub Models API)
# actionlint 1.7.3 doesn't recognize this newer permission scope
unknown permission scope "models"

# These are style warnings for consecutive echo redirects. Grouping them would
# reduce readability in our workflow context.
SC2129:style:.+: Consider using { cmd1; cmd2; } >> file instead of individual redirects

# Suppress SC2086 info for workflow input variables in .github/workflows that are controlled/safe.
# This intentionally hides SC2086 info-level warnings in workflow files; other shell scripts remain checked.
SC2086:info:.github/workflows/.+: Double quote to prevent globbing and word splitting

# GitHub Actions env: injects PYTEST_WORKERS; shellcheck still flags it as a possible
# misspelling of nearby PYTEST_* names inside the embedded pytest step script.
SC2153:info:.+: Possible misspelling: PYTEST_WORKERS may not be assigned

constant expression "false" in condition

# GitHub supports concurrency.queue (single|max); actionlint 1.7.3/1.7.11 predate it.
# Only this exact unsupported-key diagnostic is replaced by the independent
# concurrency schema checks in test_maint46_post_ci_sparse_checkout.py.
^unexpected key "queue" for "concurrency" section\. expected one of "cancel-in-progress", "group"$

# GitHub now permits 25 dispatch inputs; pinned actionlint 1.7.3 still caps at 10.
# https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#onworkflow_dispatchinputs
# The independent workflow schema/count guard rejects 26+, and the exact regex
# below ignores only the obsolete 11..25 count diagnostic (no other validation).
^maximum number of inputs for "workflow_dispatch" event is 10 but (1[1-9]|2[0-5]) inputs are provided\. see https://docs\.github\.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows#providing-inputs$
